document:0:437:0.text:
Recipe: Celestine Suspension
Appearance: A turbid, turquoise liquid that forms sediment over time, indicating instability.
Effect: Used to produce the acidolysis solution that enables precise elemental conversion during refining.
Materials: <style="highlight">Celestine powder, elemental essences, and summerbloom</style>
Preparation: Place the summerbloom in the bottom of the pot and bring the water to a boil. Then, add the remaining ingredients and keep stirring until the liquid turns turquoise. Filter and seal immediately.
document:0:437:0.source_cn:
配方：天青石悬液
形性：青蓝色液体，质地浑浊，长时间放置会有沉降，不稳定
功效：用于制作酸解液，在炼制过程中提供精准的元素转换
原材料：<style="highlight">天青石粉末，元素精华，夏末之花</style>
炼制方法：将夏末之花放入锅底等待煮沸，再放入其他原材，持续搅拌至液体呈青蓝色，过滤后快速封存
